newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST-Hong Kong Newspaper Editorials-Apr 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST-Hong Kong Newspaper Editorials-Apr 9.

text.p: There are 83 days to go before the British colony reverts to China. These are highlights of comments in the Hong Kong press. The views expressed are those of the newspapers quoted and do not represent an editorial viewpoint of Reuters.

-- ECONOMIC TIMES said the Hong Kong Government had concentrated on political issues in the past decade and failed to take effective measures to help local enterprises compete internationally. It said Hong Kong had become a high-cost city and its economic future depended on whether it could maintain its competitiveness. It said Hong Kong should develop more diversified industries apart from finance and telecommunications.

-- HONGKONG STANDARD said the fresh killings and riots in the West Bank city of Hebron underlined how little the meeting between President Bill Clinton and Israeli Premier Benjamin Netanyahu in Washington had done to produce a breakthrough in the Middle East crisis. If Israel could be persuaded to delay the building programme in East Jerusalem, the crippling impasse might be broken and the uncontrolled violence lessened.
